result_summary.title: Currency Converter: Upstream Dependency Timeouts and Errors
result_summary.description: We are seeing critical issues with the Currency Converter in ANZ production. The vendor status page shows an incident, and we are observing upstream dependency errors and timeouts. This is affecting 20,161 users. Please investigate the connection to the upstream provider and any error handling mechanisms.

incidents.summary: Sales Tax Filing Connector experienced a major incident lasting 2 hours, potentially delaying tax compliance reports.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the upstream dependency configuration and review the incident report for COMPONENT_MNJ to confirm the root cause.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The Currency Converter in ANZ production is experiencing critical issues due to an upstream dependency timeout and error. The vendor status page shows an incident, and 20,161 users are affected. The evidence suggests an upstream dependency issue, potentially caused by a third-party service failure (CAUSE_TKC). The affected component is likely COMPONENT_MNJ (Sales Tax Filing Connector), which experienced a major incident. The owning team is TEAM_JBN (Commerce / Billing). Further verification is必要
